_note: Fragment to MERGE into ~/.claude/settings.json (do not replace it). Delete the keys that start with _ when merging. Explain each key to the person before applying it.
_effortLevel: Medium reasoning effort by default: saves quota. Raise it only for hard tasks.
_plugins: Base set. Install first with /plugin (see docs/03-plugins.md); this only leaves them enabled.
_rtkHook: ONLY if you installed RTK (docs/05-save-tokens.md). `rtk init -g` normally adds it by itself; if it already exists, don't duplicate it.
